sections.title: Introduction
sections.content_original: A cocktail is an appetizer or stomach stimulant and differs from other drinks in that it is supposed to contain bitters. It is the purpose of this book to give the rules for the mixing of simple and well-known cocktails. As to rules for fancy cocktails there is no end, and the addition of the various ingredients for sweetening and blending of fancy cocktails has been left to the taste of the mixer. A dry cocktail is one in which very little, if any, sweetening is used, and is best for people who are constrained as to the use of sweets. Cocktails should always be made in a glass with cracked ice, stirred with a spoon, and sufficient ice should be used so that when the drink is served the melting of the ice will cause the drink to be at least one-third water. The finer the ice the quicker it dissolves in the liquor, and hence the colder the drink. A cocktail should never be bottled and should always be made at the time of drinking. A bottled cocktail might be likened unto a depot sandwich-neither are fit for use except in case of necessity. The original cocktails were all made from Gin, Whiskey or Brandy, and these are the spirits used in almost every well-known cocktail made today. The addition of Vermouth was the first move toward the blending of cocktails and was the initial feature that led to their popularity. The measures referred to, namely, a mixing-glass, a jigger, and a pony, hold the following quantities: A mixing glass holds 12 ounces, 6 jiggers, or 24 medium size tablespoonfuls. A jigger referred to in these rules holds 2 ounces, or 4 medium size tablespoonfuls. A pony holds 1 ounce, or half a jigger, or 2 tablespoonfuls. The formulas are simple, practical, easy to follow, and the ingredients are embraced within the contents of the sideboard of the average well-regulated household. The cherry preserved in Maraschino and the small green olive are often dropped in the bottom of the cocktail glass. As to whether the cherry or olive be used, it is a matter of taste, but on general principles the cherry should go with the sweet drink and the olive with the dry. Neither the cherry nor the olive should ever be served with the drink without first learning whether it is desired or not. An old-fashioned yet attractive way of serving a cocktail to ladies is the wiping of the rim of the cocktail glass with lemon peel and then dipping the rim in powdered sugar, which leaves a frosty decoration on the rim of the glass. Angostura Bitters may be used in place of Baker's where mentioned in these rules, if preferred, but never more than one-half the quantity. Orange Bitters may be used in conjunction with the other bitters mentioned, or alone, and the addition of a dash or two, more or less, of these bitters is far from being objectionable, as in the case of the more pungent bitters. The writer has no caution to give as to any extras that may be added; the only special suggestion he has to offer being-always make cocktails mild and avoid too many bitters. The tinkle of the ice-the delightful odor of the lemon peel-the fragrance and flavor of this ice-cold appetizer, what an apology it has been for cold soup and overdone entree!
sections.content_es: Un cóctel es un aperitivo o estimulante estomacal y se diferencia de otras bebidas en que se supone que contiene amargos (bitters). El propósito de este libro es dar las reglas para mezclar cócteles sencillos y bien conocidos. En cuanto a las reglas para los cócteles 'fancy' (de fantasía), no tienen fin, y la adición de los diversos ingredientes para endulzar y mezclar cócteles fancy se ha dejado al gusto del barman. Un cóctel seco es aquel en el que se usa muy poco, si es que se usa algo, de endulzante, y es el más adecuado para personas que tienen restringido el consumo de dulces. Los cócteles deben prepararse siempre en un vaso con hielo picado, removidos con una cuchara, y debe usarse suficiente hielo para que, cuando se sirva la bebida, la fusión del hielo haga que esta sea al menos un tercio agua. Cuanto más fino sea el hielo, más rápido se disuelve en el licor y, por lo tanto, más fría queda la bebida. Un cóctel nunca debe embotellarse y siempre debe prepararse en el momento de beberlo. Un cóctel embotellado podría compararse con un sándwich de estación: ninguno de los dos sirve, salvo en caso de necesidad. Los cócteles originales se hacían todos con gin, whisky o brandy, y estos son los licores que se usan en casi todos los cócteles conocidos hoy en día. La adición del vermut fue el primer paso hacia la mezcla de cócteles y fue la característica inicial que condujo a su popularidad. Las medidas a las que se hace referencia, es decir, mixing-glass, jigger y pony, tienen las siguientes capacidades: un mixing-glass contiene 12 onzas, 6 jiggers o 24 cucharadas medianas. Un jigger, tal y como se menciona en estas reglas, contiene 2 onzas, o 4 cucharadas medianas. Un pony contiene 1 onza, o medio jigger, o 2 cucharadas. Las fórmulas son sencillas, prácticas, fáciles de seguir, y los ingredientes están dentro de lo que contiene el aparador de cualquier hogar bien provisto. La cereza conservada en marrasquino y la pequeña aceituna verde se ponen a menudo en el fondo de la copa de cóctel. Que se use la cereza o la aceituna es cuestión de gusto, pero como principio general la cereza debería ir con la bebida dulce y la aceituna con la seca. Ni la cereza ni la aceituna deben servirse nunca con la bebida sin antes preguntar si se desean. Una forma anticuada pero atractiva de servir un cóctel a las damas consiste en frotar el borde de la copa con cáscara de limón y luego sumergir el borde en azúcar glas, lo que deja una decoración escarchada en el borde de la copa. Pueden usarse amargos de Angostura en lugar de los de Baker's cuando se mencionen en estas reglas, si se prefiere, pero nunca más de la mitad de la cantidad. Los amargos de naranja pueden usarse junto con los otros amargos mencionados, o solos, y añadir un par de dashes, más o menos, de estos amargos no resulta nada desagradable, a diferencia de lo que ocurre con los amargos más punzantes. El autor no advierte sobre ningún extra que pueda añadirse; la única sugerencia especial que ofrece es: haz siempre los cócteles suaves y evita demasiados amargos. El tintineo del hielo, el delicioso aroma de la cáscara de limón, la fragancia y el sabor de este aperitivo helado, ¡qué disculpa han sido para una sopa fría y un entrante demasiado hecho!

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Peyschaud o de Boker

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes Peyschaud or Boker's bitters, one jigger apple brandy. Mix and strain into a cocktail-glass. Add a piece of twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir dos dashes de amargo de Peyschaud o de Boker y un jigger de aguardiente de manzana. Mezclar y colar en una copa de cóctel. Añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Apple Brandy Cocktail. MIXING-GLASS half-full fine ice, two dashes Peyschaud or Boker's bitters, one jigger apple brandy. Mix and strain into a cocktail-glass. Add a piece of twisted lemon peel.

recipes.method_original: Use ice in mixing-glass, three dashes orange bitters, half a jigger sherry, half a jigger Italian vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece of orange peel.
recipes.method_es: Poner hielo en el mixing-glass, tres dashes de amargo de naranja, medio jigger de jerez y medio jigger de vermut italiano. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel. Añadir un trozo de cáscara de naranja.
recipes.raw_text: Armour Cocktail. Use ice in mixing-glass, three dashes orange bitters, half a jigger sherry, half a jigger Italian vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece of orange peel.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Peyschaud o de Boker

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Peyschaud or Boker's bitters, one jigger brandy. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir dos dashes de jarabe de goma, dos dashes de amargo de Peyschaud o de Boker y un jigger de brandy. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel. Añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Brandy Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Peyschaud or Boker's bitters, one jigger brandy. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece twisted lemon peel.

recipes.name_es: Cóctel de Brandy a la Antigua
recipes.method_original: Crush lump of sugar in a whiskey-glass with sufficient hot water to cover the sugar, add one lump ice, two dashes bitters, a small piece lemon peel, one jigger brandy. Stir with small bar-spoon. Serve leaving spoon in the glass.
recipes.method_es: Aplastar un terrón de azúcar en un vaso de whisky con suficiente agua caliente para cubrirlo, añadir un trozo de hielo, dos dashes de amargo, un trocito de cáscara de limón y un jigger de brandy. Remover con una cucharilla de bar pequeña. Servir dejando la cucharilla en el vaso.
recipes.raw_text: Brandy Cocktail-Old-Fashioned. Crush lump of sugar in a whiskey-glass with sufficient hot water to cover the sugar, add one lump ice, two dashes bitters, a small piece lemon peel, one jigger brandy. Stir with small bar-spoon. Serve leaving spoon in the glass.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Peyschaud o de Baker

recipes.method_original: Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add three dashes Maraschino, two dashes Peyschaud or Baker's bitters, one jigger brandy, one dash orange bitters. Mix. Strain into cocktail-glass, the rim of which has been moistened with a piece of lemon and dipped in powdered sugar.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir tres dashes de marrasquino, dos dashes de amargo de Peyschaud o de Baker, un jigger de brandy y un dash de amargo de naranja. Mezclar. Colar en una copa de cóctel cuyo borde se ha humedecido con un trozo de limón y luego se ha pasado por azúcar glas.
recipes.garnish: rim moistened with lemon and dipped in powdered sugar
recipes.raw_text: Brandy Cocktail-Fancy. Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add three dashes Maraschino, two dashes Peyschaud or Baker's bitters, one jigger brandy, one dash orange bitters. Mix. Strain into cocktail-glass, the rim of which has been moistened with a piece of lemon and dipped in powdered sugar.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes Angostura bitters, one-third of a jigger White Creme de menthe, two-thirds of a jigger brandy. Mix well. Strain into cocktail-glass; twist a piece of lemon peel over the top.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir dos dashes de amargo de Angostura, un tercio de jigger de crema de menta blanca y dos tercios de jigger de brandy. Mezclar bien. Colar en copa de cóctel; retorcer un trozo de cáscara de limón sobre la superficie.
recipes.garnish: lemon peel twisted over the top
recipes.raw_text: Brant Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes Angostura bitters, one-third of a jigger White Creme de menthe, two-thirds of a jigger brandy. Mix well. Strain into cocktail-glass; twist a piece of lemon peel over the top.

recipes.method_original: Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add three dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Holland gin, one-half jigger French vermouth; shake until cold. Strain into cocktail-glass; twist a small piece lemon peel on top.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir tres dashes de amargo de Boker, medio jigger de ginebra holandesa y medio jigger de vermut francés; agitar hasta que esté frío. Colar en copa de cóctel; retorcer un trocito de cáscara de limón sobre la superficie.
recipes.garnish: small lemon peel twisted on top
recipes.raw_text: Brown Cocktail. Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add three dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Holland gin, one-half jigger French vermouth; shake until cold. Strain into cocktail-glass; twist a small piece lemon peel on top.

recipes.method_original: Half a jigger Calasaya, half a jigger whiskey, one small piece lemon peel, half a mixing-glass full fine ice. Mix well and strain into a cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Medio jigger de Calasaya, medio jigger de whisky, un trocito de cáscara de limón y medio mixing-glass de hielo fino. Mezclar bien y colar en una copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Calasaya Cocktail. Half a jigger Calasaya, half a jigger whiskey, one small piece lemon peel, half a mixing-glass full fine ice. Mix well and strain into a cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes of orange bitters, two dashes Boker's bitters, one piece lemon peel, one jigger rye whiskey-no sweetening. Mix and strain into a cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir dos dashes de amargo de naranja, dos dashes de amargo de Boker, un trozo de cáscara de limón y un jigger de whisky de centeno (sin endulzar). Mezclar y colar en una copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Country Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes of orange bitters, two dashes Boker's bitters, one piece lemon peel, one jigger rye whiskey-no sweetening. Mix and strain into a cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Put into a long thin glass one lump cut-loaf sugar saturated with Boker's bitters, add one lump of ice, a fair sized piece of lemon peel; fill the glass three-fourths full cold champagne. Stir with spoon and serve.
recipes.method_es: Poner en un vaso largo y fino un terrón de azúcar empapado en amargo de Boker, añadir un trozo de hielo y un buen trozo de cáscara de limón; llenar el vaso hasta tres cuartos con champán frío. Remover con cuchara y servir.
recipes.raw_text: Champagne Cocktail. Put into a long thin glass one lump cut-loaf sugar saturated with Boker's bitters, add one lump of ice, a fair sized piece of lemon peel; fill the glass three-fourths full cold champagne. Stir with spoon and serve.

ingredients.notes: to wet one of the sugar lumps

recipes.method_original: Into a long thin glass, put two lumps of sugar; wet one of the lumps with Peyschaud bitters. Add three lumps of ice and the rind of a lemon. Catch one end of the lemon rind on the edge of the glass. Fill the glass nearly full with cold champagne. Stir with a bar-spoon and serve.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso largo y fino, poner dos terrones de azúcar; humedecer uno de ellos con amargo de Peyschaud. Añadir tres trozos de hielo y la cáscara de un limón. Enganchar un extremo de la cáscara de limón en el borde del vaso. Llenar el vaso casi por completo con champán frío. Remover con una cuchara de bar y servir.
recipes.garnish: lemon rind hooked on the rim
recipes.raw_text: Champagne Cocktail-Fancy. Into a long thin glass, put two lumps of sugar; wet one of the lumps with Peyschaud bitters. Add three lumps of ice and the rind of a lemon. Catch one end of the lemon rind on the edge of the glass. Fill the glass nearly full with cold champagne. Stir with a bar-spoon and serve.

recipes.method_original: Break a fresh egg into a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add one dash bitters, one jigger port wine, one teaspoonful fine sugar. Shake well and strain into a cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Romper un huevo fresco en un mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, añadir un dash de amargo, un jigger de vino de Oporto y una cucharadita de azúcar fina. Agitar bien y colar en una copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Chocolate Cocktail. Break a fresh egg into a mixing-glass, half full fine ice, add one dash bitters, one jigger port wine, one teaspoonful fine sugar. Shake well and strain into a cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Saturate a lump of cut-loaf sugar with Baker's bitters. Place it, with one lump of ice and a small piece of lemon peel, in a thin cider-glass, then fill up with cold cider. Stir with spoon and serve.
recipes.method_es: Empapar un terrón de azúcar con amargo de Baker. Colocarlo, junto con un trozo de hielo y un trocito de cáscara de limón, en un vaso fino para sidra, y luego llenar con sidra fría. Remover con cuchara y servir.
recipes.raw_text: Cider Cocktail. Saturate a lump of cut-loaf sugar with Baker's bitters. Place it, with one lump of ice and a small piece of lemon peel, in a thin cider-glass, then fill up with cold cider. Stir with spoon and serve.

recipes.method_original: Put into a large cocktail-glass a half-dozen little-neck clams with all their liquor, season with pepper and salt to taste; add two dashes lemon-juice, one dash Tabasco sauce, and a very little cayenne pepper. Serve with small fork or spoon in glass.
recipes.method_es: Poner en una copa grande de cóctel media docena de almejas little-neck con todo su líquido, sazonar con sal y pimienta al gusto; añadir dos dashes de zumo de limón, un dash de salsa Tabasco y muy poca pimienta de cayena. Servir con un tenedor o cucharilla pequeños dentro de la copa.
recipes.raw_text: Clam Cocktail. Put into a large cocktail-glass a half-dozen little-neck clams with all their liquor, season with pepper and salt to taste; add two dashes lemon-juice, one dash Tabasco sauce, and a very little cayenne pepper. Serve with small fork or spoon in glass.

recipes.method_original: Fill a mixing-glass half-full of fine ice; add one teaspoonful of powdered white sugar, one fresh egg, one pony port wine, one pony of brandy. Shake thoroughly and strain into a large cocktail-glass. Grate a little nutmeg on top before serving.
recipes.method_es: Llenar un mixing-glass hasta la mitad de hielo fino; añadir una cucharadita de azúcar blanca en polvo, un huevo fresco, un pony de Oporto y un pony de brandy. Agitar bien y colar en una copa grande de cóctel. Rallar un poco de nuez moscada por encima antes de servir.
recipes.raw_text: Coffee Cocktail. Fill a mixing-glass half-full of fine ice; add one teaspoonful of powdered white sugar, one fresh egg, one pony port wine, one pony of brandy. Shake thoroughly and strain into a large cocktail-glass. Grate a little nutmeg on top before serving.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Boker o de Peyschaud

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes Boker's or Peyschaud bitters, two dashes gum-syrup, one jigger Holland gin. Mix; strain into a cocktail-glass. Add a piece of twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, dos dashes de amargo de Boker o de Peyschaud, dos dashes de jarabe de goma y un jigger de ginebra holandesa. Mezclar; colar en una copa de cóctel. Añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Gin Cocktail-Holland. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes Boker's or Peyschaud bitters, two dashes gum-syrup, one jigger Holland gin. Mix; strain into a cocktail-glass. Add a piece of twisted lemon peel.

recipes.name_es: Cóctel de Gin Holandesa a la Antigua
recipes.method_original: Put a lump of sugar in a whiskey glass; add enough hot water to cover the sugar. Crush the sugar; add a lump of ice, two dashes Boker's bitters, small piece of lemon peel, one jigger of Holland gin. Mix with small bar-spoon and serve with spoon in glass.
recipes.method_es: Poner un terrón de azúcar en un vaso de whisky; añadir suficiente agua caliente para cubrir el azúcar. Aplastar el azúcar; añadir un trozo de hielo, dos dashes de amargo de Boker, un trocito de cáscara de limón y un jigger de ginebra holandesa. Mezclar con cucharilla pequeña de bar y servir con la cucharilla en el vaso.
recipes.raw_text: Gin Cocktail-Old-Fashioned Holland. Put a lump of sugar in a whiskey glass; add enough hot water to cover the sugar. Crush the sugar; add a lump of ice, two dashes Boker's bitters, small piece of lemon peel, one jigger of Holland gin. Mix with small bar-spoon and serve with spoon in glass.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de naranja o de Peyschaud

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange or Peyschaud bitters, one jigger Plymouth gin. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass. Add a small piece lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, tres dashes de amargo de naranja o de Peyschaud y un jigger de ginebra Plymouth. Mezclar bien, colar en copa de cóctel. Añadir un trocito de cáscara de limón.
recipes.raw_text: Gin Cocktail-Plymouth. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange or Peyschaud bitters, one jigger Plymouth gin. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass. Add a small piece lemon peel.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Peyschaud o de Baker

recipes.method_original: Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice; add two dashes Peyschaud or Baker's bitters, one jigger Tom gin. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass and add a small piece of lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino; añadir dos dashes de amargo de Peyschaud o de Baker y un jigger de Tom gin. Mezclar bien, colar en copa de cóctel y añadir un trocito de cáscara de limón.
recipes.raw_text: Gin Cocktail-Tom. Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice; add two dashes Peyschaud or Baker's bitters, one jigger Tom gin. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass and add a small piece of lemon peel.

recipes.name_es: Cóctel de Tom Gin a la Antigua
recipes.method_original: Mix same as Old Fashioned Holland Gin Cocktail, using Old Tom gin in place of Holland.
recipes.method_es: Preparar igual que el Cóctel de Gin Holandesa a la Antigua, usando Old Tom gin en lugar de ginebra holandesa.
recipes.raw_text: Gin Cocktail-Old-Fashioned Tom. Mix same as Old Fashioned Holland Gin Cocktail, using Old Tom gin in place of Holland.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full of fine ice; one dash gum-syrup, three dashes Boker's bitters, half a jigger Italian vermouth, half a jigger of brandy. Mix and strain into a cocktail-glass, then fill up with seltzer and serve quickly.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino; un dash de jarabe de goma, tres dashes de amargo de Boker, medio jigger de vermut italiano y medio jigger de brandy. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel, luego completar con seltz y servir rápidamente.
recipes.raw_text: Harvard Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full of fine ice; one dash gum-syrup, three dashes Boker's bitters, half a jigger Italian vermouth, half a jigger of brandy. Mix and strain into a cocktail-glass, then fill up with seltzer and serve quickly.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, two dashes Horsford's acid phosphate, one-half jigger whiskey, one-half jigger Italian vermouth. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, tres dashes de amargo de naranja, dos dashes de fosfato ácido de Horsford, medio jigger de whisky y medio jigger de vermut italiano. Mezclar bien, colar en copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Irish Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, two dashes Horsford's acid phosphate, one-half jigger whiskey, one-half jigger Italian vermouth. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes orange bitters, two dashes Baker's bitters, one jigger Jamaica rum. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Add a small piece twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, dos dashes de jarabe de goma, dos dashes de amargo de naranja, dos dashes de amargo de Baker y un jigger de ron de Jamaica. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel. Añadir un trocito de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Jamaica Rum Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes orange bitters, two dashes Baker's bitters, one jigger Jamaica rum. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Add a small piece twisted lemon peel.

recipes.method_original: Put one lump of ice in thin cider-glass. Add one-half tablespoonful fine sugar, two dashes Boker's bitters, one piece lemon peel. Fill up with cold cider. Stir well, and drink while effervescent.
recipes.method_es: Poner un trozo de hielo en un vaso fino de sidra. Añadir media cucharada de azúcar fina, dos dashes de amargo de Boker y un trozo de cáscara de limón. Completar con sidra fría. Remover bien y beber mientras hace efervescencia.
recipes.raw_text: Jersey Cocktail. Put one lump of ice in thin cider-glass. Add one-half tablespoonful fine sugar, two dashes Boker's bitters, one piece lemon peel. Fill up with cold cider. Stir well, and drink while effervescent.

recipes.method_original: Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add one dash syrup, half a jigger Picon bitters, half a jigger whiskey. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. A small piece of lemon peel on top.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir un dash de jarabe, medio jigger de amargo Picon y medio jigger de whisky. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel. Un trocito de cáscara de limón por encima.
recipes.raw_text: Liberal Cocktail. Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add one dash syrup, half a jigger Picon bitters, half a jigger whiskey. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. A small piece of lemon peel on top.

recipes.method_original: Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, one-half jigger whiskey. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece of lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir dos dashes de jarabe de goma, dos dashes de amargo de Boker, medio jigger de vermut italiano y medio jigger de whisky. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel. Añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón.
recipes.raw_text: Manhattan Cocktail. Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, one-half jigger whiskey. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece of lemon peel.

recipes.method_original: Prepare same as Manhattan Cocktail, leaving out syrup.
recipes.method_es: Preparar igual que el Cóctel Manhattan, omitiendo el jarabe.
recipes.raw_text: Manhattan Cocktail-Dry. Prepare same as Manhattan Cocktail, leaving out syrup.

recipes.method_original: Mix same as Manhattan Cocktail. Leave out syrup, and use French vermouth in place of Italian.
recipes.method_es: Mezclar igual que el Cóctel Manhattan. Omitir el jarabe y usar vermut francés en lugar de italiano.
recipes.raw_text: Manhattan Cocktail-Extra Dry. Mix same as Manhattan Cocktail. Leave out syrup, and use French vermouth in place of Italian.

ingredients.notes: in the bottom of the glass

recipes.method_original: Half a mixing-glass full of fine ice, three dashes of orange bitters, one-half jigger of Plymouth gin, one-half jigger of French vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. Place an olive in the bottom of glass and serve.
recipes.method_es: Medio mixing-glass de hielo fino, tres dashes de amargo de naranja, medio jigger de ginebra Plymouth y medio jigger de vermut francés. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel. Poner una aceituna en el fondo de la copa y servir.
recipes.raw_text: Marguerite Cocktail. Half a mixing-glass full of fine ice, three dashes of orange bitters, one-half jigger of Plymouth gin, one-half jigger of French vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass. Place an olive in the bottom of glass and serve.

recipes.method_original: Half a mixing-glass full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, one-half jigger Tom gin, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, a piece lemon peel. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Medio mixing-glass de hielo fino, tres dashes de amargo de naranja, medio jigger de Tom gin, medio jigger de vermut italiano y un trozo de cáscara de limón. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Martini Cocktail-No. 1. Half a mixing-glass full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, one-half jigger Tom gin, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, a piece lemon peel. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Tom gin, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, half a teaspoonful sherry, piece of lemon peel. Mix, and strain into cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino. Añadir dos dashes de amargo de Boker, medio jigger de Tom gin, medio jigger de vermut italiano, media cucharadita de jerez y un trozo de cáscara de limón. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Martini Cocktail-No. 2. Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Tom gin, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, half a teaspoonful sherry, piece of lemon peel. Mix, and strain into cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add dash gum-syrup, two dashes Boker's bitters, one jigger Medford rum. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece of twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino. Añadir un dash de jarabe de goma, dos dashes de amargo de Boker y un jigger de ron Medford. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel. Añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Medford Rum Cocktail. Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add dash gum-syrup, two dashes Boker's bitters, one jigger Medford rum. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Add a piece of twisted lemon peel.

recipes.method_original: Have a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Peyschaud bitters, one dash orange bitters, half a jigger brandy, half a jigger French vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass, add small piece twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir dos dashes de jarabe de goma, dos dashes de amargo de Peyschaud, un dash de amargo de naranja, medio jigger de brandy y medio jigger de vermut francés. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel y añadir un trocito de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Metropole Cocktail. Have a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Peyschaud bitters, one dash orange bitters, half a jigger brandy, half a jigger French vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass, add small piece twisted lemon peel.

recipes.method_original: Two lumps of ice in a small wine-glass, add three dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Boker's bitters, one pony brandy, one pony French vermouth. Mix, take out the ice, add a small piece twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Dos trozos de hielo en una copa de vino pequeña, añadir tres dashes de jarabe de goma, dos dashes de amargo de Boker, un pony de brandy y un pony de vermut francés. Mezclar, retirar el hielo y añadir un trocito de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Metropolitan Cocktail. Two lumps of ice in a small wine-glass, add three dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Boker's bitters, one pony brandy, one pony French vermouth. Mix, take out the ice, add a small piece twisted lemon peel.

recipes.method_original: A few dashes lemon juice in a tumbler, add a dash of Tabasco sauce, a teaspoonful of vinegar, a few dashes tomato catsup, six Blue Point oysters, with all their liquor; season to taste with pepper and salt. Mix and serve with small fork or spoon in the glass.
recipes.method_es: Unos dashes de zumo de limón en un vaso, añadir un dash de salsa Tabasco, una cucharadita de vinagre, unos dashes de ketchup, seis ostras Blue Point con todo su líquido; sazonar con sal y pimienta al gusto. Mezclar y servir con un tenedor o cuchara pequeños en el vaso.
recipes.raw_text: Oyster Cocktail. A few dashes lemon juice in a tumbler, add a dash of Tabasco sauce, a teaspoonful of vinegar, a few dashes tomato catsup, six Blue Point oysters, with all their liquor; season to taste with pepper and salt. Mix and serve with small fork or spoon in the glass.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, one and a half pony Tom gin. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add half a pony port wine carefully and let it settle in bottom of cocktail before serving.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, tres dashes de amargo de naranja y un pony y medio de Tom gin. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel; añadir con cuidado medio pony de Oporto y dejar que se asiente en el fondo del cóctel antes de servir.
recipes.raw_text: Princeton Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, one and a half pony Tom gin. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add half a pony port wine carefully and let it settle in bottom of cocktail before serving.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, one dash Angostura bitters, a small bar-spoonful Horsford's Acid Phosphate, one jigger Calasaya. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, un dash de amargo de Angostura, una cucharadita pequeña de bar de fosfato ácido de Horsford y un jigger de Calasaya. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Riding Club Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, one dash Angostura bitters, a small bar-spoonful Horsford's Acid Phosphate, one jigger Calasaya. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Scotch whiskey, one-half jigger Italian vermouth. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Place a small piece lemon peel on top.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino. Añadir dos dashes de amargo de Boker, medio jigger de whisky escocés y medio jigger de vermut italiano. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel. Colocar un trocito de cáscara de limón por encima.
recipes.raw_text: Rob Roy Cocktail. Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger Scotch whiskey, one-half jigger Italian vermouth. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass. Place a small piece lemon peel on top.

recipes.method_original: One teaspoonful fine sugar in a large bar-glass, one lump of ice, three dashes Peyschaud bitters, one piece lemon peel; add one bottle of plain or lemon soda. Mix and drink during effervescence.
recipes.method_es: Una cucharadita de azúcar fina en un vaso grande de bar, un trozo de hielo, tres dashes de amargo de Peyschaud y un trozo de cáscara de limón; añadir una botella de soda natural o de limón. Mezclar y beber durante la efervescencia.
recipes.raw_text: Soda Cocktail. One teaspoonful fine sugar in a large bar-glass, one lump of ice, three dashes Peyschaud bitters, one piece lemon peel; add one bottle of plain or lemon soda. Mix and drink during effervescence.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Peyschaud o de Baker

recipes.method_original: Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add two dashes gum-syrup, three dashes Peyschaud or Baker's bitters, one-half jigger apple brandy, one-half jigger Italian vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass, twist small piece lemon peel on top.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, añadir dos dashes de jarabe de goma, tres dashes de amargo de Peyschaud o de Baker, medio jigger de aguardiente de manzana y medio jigger de vermut italiano. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel y retorcer un trocito de cáscara de limón por encima.
recipes.garnish: small twisted lemon peel on top
recipes.raw_text: Star Cocktail. Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, add two dashes gum-syrup, three dashes Peyschaud or Baker's bitters, one-half jigger apple brandy, one-half jigger Italian vermouth. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass, twist small piece lemon peel on top.

recipes.method_original: One dash Angostura bitters, three dashes orange bitters, one jigger Tom gin in a mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add a piece twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Un dash de amargo de Angostura, tres dashes de amargo de naranja y un jigger de Tom gin en un mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel; añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Turf Cocktail. One dash Angostura bitters, three dashes orange bitters, one jigger Tom gin in a mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add a piece twisted lemon peel.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Boker o de Peyschaud

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes Boker's or Peyschaud bitters, one jigger Italian vermouth. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass; add a piece lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, dos dashes de amargo de Boker o de Peyschaud y un jigger de vermut italiano. Mezclar bien, colar en copa de cóctel; añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón.
recipes.raw_text: Vermouth Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes Boker's or Peyschaud bitters, one jigger Italian vermouth. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass; add a piece lemon peel.

ingredients.item_es: amargo de Boker o de Peyschaud

recipes.method_original: Prepare same as Vermouth Cocktail, using French vermouth in place of Italian; twist a piece lemon peel over top.
recipes.method_es: Preparar igual que el Cóctel de Vermut, usando vermut francés en lugar del italiano; retorcer un trozo de cáscara de limón sobre la superficie.
recipes.raw_text: Vermouth Cocktail-Dry. Prepare same as Vermouth Cocktail, using French vermouth in place of Italian; twist a piece lemon peel over top.

recipes.method_original: Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add three dashes Maraschino, two dashes Boker's bitters, one jigger Italian vermouth and one dash orange bitters. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass, the rim of which has been moistened with a piece of lemon peel and dipped in powdered sugar.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino. Añadir tres dashes de marrasquino, dos dashes de amargo de Boker, un jigger de vermut italiano y un dash de amargo de naranja. Mezclar y colar en una copa de cóctel cuyo borde se ha humedecido con un trozo de cáscara de limón y luego se ha pasado por azúcar glas.
recipes.garnish: rim moistened with lemon peel and dipped in powdered sugar
recipes.raw_text: Vermouth Cocktail-Fancy. Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add three dashes Maraschino, two dashes Boker's bitters, one jigger Italian vermouth and one dash orange bitters. Mix and strain into cocktail-glass, the rim of which has been moistened with a piece of lemon peel and dipped in powdered sugar.

recipes.method_original: Three dashes orange bitters in mixing-glass half-full fine ice; add one jigger French vermouth. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass; add a piece twisted lemon peel on top.
recipes.method_es: Tres dashes de amargo de naranja en mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino; añadir un jigger de vermut francés. Mezclar bien, colar en copa de cóctel; añadir un trozo de cáscara de limón retorcida por encima.
recipes.raw_text: Vermouth Cocktail-French. Three dashes orange bitters in mixing-glass half-full fine ice; add one jigger French vermouth. Mix well, strain into cocktail-glass; add a piece twisted lemon peel on top.

recipes.method_original: Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Peyschaud bitters, one jigger whiskey. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add a small piece of twisted lemon peel.
recipes.method_es: Mixing-glass medio lleno de hielo fino, dos dashes de jarabe de goma, dos dashes de amargo de Peyschaud y un jigger de whisky. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel; añadir un trocito de cáscara de limón retorcida.
recipes.raw_text: Whiskey Cocktail. Mixing-glass half-full fine ice, two dashes gum-syrup, two dashes Peyschaud bitters, one jigger whiskey. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add a small piece of twisted lemon peel.

recipes.method_original: Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Maraschino, two dashes Boker's bitters, one jigger whiskey, one dash orange bitters. Mix until very cold. Strain into cocktail-glass, the rim of which has been moistened with a piece of lemon peel and dipped in powdered sugar.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino. Añadir dos dashes de marrasquino, dos dashes de amargo de Boker, un jigger de whisky y un dash de amargo de naranja. Mezclar hasta que esté muy frío. Colar en una copa de cóctel cuyo borde se ha humedecido con un trozo de cáscara de limón y se ha pasado por azúcar glas.
recipes.garnish: rim moistened with lemon peel and dipped in powdered sugar
recipes.raw_text: Whiskey Cocktail-Fancy. Have mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Maraschino, two dashes Boker's bitters, one jigger whiskey, one dash orange bitters. Mix until very cold. Strain into cocktail-glass, the rim of which has been moistened with a piece of lemon peel and dipped in powdered sugar.

recipes.name_es: Cóctel de Whisky a la Antigua
recipes.method_original: Put a lump of sugar in a whiskey glass; add enough hot water to cover the sugar. Crush the sugar; add a lump of ice, two dashes Boker's bitters, small piece of lemon peel, one jigger whiskey. Mix with small bar-spoon and serve with spoon in glass.
recipes.method_es: Poner un terrón de azúcar en un vaso de whisky; añadir suficiente agua caliente para cubrirlo. Aplastar el azúcar; añadir un trozo de hielo, dos dashes de amargo de Boker, un trocito de cáscara de limón y un jigger de whisky. Mezclar con cucharilla pequeña de bar y servir con la cucharilla en el vaso.
recipes.raw_text: Whiskey Cocktail-Old-Fashioned. Put a lump of sugar in a whiskey glass; add enough hot water to cover the sugar. Crush the sugar; add a lump of ice, two dashes Boker's bitters, small piece of lemon peel, one jigger whiskey. Mix with small bar-spoon and serve with spoon in glass.

recipes.method_original: Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger whiskey, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, half a teaspoonful sherry, piece of lemon peel. Mix, and strain into cocktail-glass.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino. Añadir dos dashes de amargo de Boker, medio jigger de whisky, medio jigger de vermut italiano, media cucharadita de jerez y un trozo de cáscara de limón. Mezclar y colar en copa de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text: Whiskey Cocktail-New York. Fill mixing-glass half-full fine ice. Add two dashes Boker's bitters, one-half jigger whiskey, one-half jigger Italian vermouth, half a teaspoonful sherry, piece of lemon peel. Mix, and strain into cocktail-glass.

recipes.method_original: Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, one dash Peyschaud bitters, a piece lemon peel, one jigger Tom gin. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add a squirt of siphon seltzer.
recipes.method_es: Llenar el mixing-glass hasta la mitad con hielo fino, tres dashes de amargo de naranja, un dash de amargo de Peyschaud, un trozo de cáscara de limón y un jigger de Tom gin. Mezclar, colar en copa de cóctel; añadir un chorro de sifón de seltz.
recipes.raw_text: Yale Cocktail. Fill a mixing-glass half-full fine ice, three dashes orange bitters, one dash Peyschaud bitters, a piece lemon peel, one jigger Tom gin. Mix, strain into cocktail-glass; add a squirt of siphon seltzer.
